# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Applied the two requested fixes in the current branch: I hardened the remaining shrimp molt GH divisions with the same defensive zero-floor handling already used by the sibling GH helpers, and I recalibrated the long-horizon denitrification regression so it now validates denitrification through total-nitrogen loss plus explicit N2 export under the current substrate-oxygenation model instead of a brittle nitrate-only comparison. Targeted molt/mineral and denitrification coverage now pass with the updated assertions and guard behavior.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the review findings, then patched the remaining `gh_min_d`-based molt calculations to use the same defensive lower bound as the existing GH helper paths.
2. [Completed] Reworked the long-horizon denitrification regression fixture/assertions so the active denitrifying bed is validated against the oxic control through exported N2 and lower total system nitrogen, which stays stable under the newer substrate oxygenation behavior.
3. [Completed] Ran targeted regressions for denitrification and molt/mineral behavior, then ran broader `tank_core` validation to capture the remaining unrelated reproduction-factor failures.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test denitrification -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test molt_mineral_budget -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test reproduction_factors -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core -- --nocapture`

## Outstanding Risks

- `cargo test -p tank_core -- --nocapture` still fails in `crates/tank_core/tests/reproduction_factors.rs` on `test_egg_dropping_from_sudden_change`, `test_reproduction_increases_with_condition`, and `test_mature_stable_tank_breeds_well`; those failures come from pre-existing reproduction/snapshot work already present in the dirty tree and were not widened into this pass.
